suite: Module 36 — Customer Web + Restaurant Dashboard + Platform Admin on the real local backend (ledger, commission, earnings, holds, refund liability, settlements, payouts, provider settlement import, reconciliation, checks) with a finance queue worker, two API processes for the double-submit steps, the DEVELOPMENT payment provider and the DEVELOPMENT payout provider (PAYMENT_DRIVER=fake, PAYOUT_DRIVER=fake) — NO MONEY MOVES; LIVE PAYOUT = DISABLED; the Razorpay settlement reader is NOT exercised (no credentials on this machine: PENDING PROVIDER VERIFICATION); every commission rate and provider fee is a TEST FIXTURE

results.name: A1 PAYMENT → LEDGER: the verified payment of the order is ONE balanced posting (key payment:{id}:verified): the provider holds the customer money for the platform (Dr PROVIDER_CLEARING / Cr PAYMENT_CLEARING, the order total) — nobody has earned anything, no commission exists yet

A2 ORDER → ALLOCATION: the order has ONE financial allocation, frozen with the terms of the moment it was placed — the TEST FIXTURE plan of this machine (1000 basis points of the merchandise; NOT a production commission) — and it is PENDING: an order that is not completed is not an earning

A3 THE RESTAURANT DASHBOARD API SAYS SO (GET /restaurant/finance/summary): pending = the estimated net of the order in progress, available 0, paid out 0, balance 0 — with the words that say what each figure means and that live payouts are not enabled

A4 COMPLETION → EARNINGS: when the order is COMPLETED (pickup verified) its allocation is RECOGNIZED in ONE balanced posting (key order:{id}:recognized): Dr PAYMENT_CLEARING total / Cr RESTAURANT_PAYABLE net + Cr PLATFORM_COMMISSION_REVENUE commission; the customer money left clearing, the restaurant is owed the net, and the earning is ONE payable line (AVAILABLE)

A5 IDEMPOTENT: after a second completed order the sweep and the backfill (php artisan finance:post-pending [--backfill]) find nothing to post — the same payments, orders and earnings are in the ledger once; every transaction balances

B1 A REJECTED ORDER EARNS NOTHING: its allocation is VOID (no posting, no payable line); when its refund is CONFIRMED by the provider the customer money goes back out of clearing (key refund:{id}:completed: Dr PAYMENT_CLEARING / Cr PROVIDER_CLEARING) — no liability to decide, the restaurant payable and the commission are untouched

B2 AN OPEN REFUND HOLDS THE EARNING IT IS ABOUT (a switchable policy, PENDING BUSINESS APPROVAL): asking for a partial refund of a completed, unsettled order places a SYSTEM hold REFUND_PENDING on that order's payable line — held is still the restaurant's (the ledger balance did not change), it is only not settled

B3 REFUND → LEDGER for an order that HAD been recognized: the confirmed refund leaves the provider (Cr PROVIDER_CLEARING) and waits in REFUND_CLEARING — nobody is charged yet. Who bears it is a recorded decision (REFUND_LIABILITY, PENDING_DECISION, UNASSIGNED: no liability policy is approved); the hold is released; the dashboard showed the held amount while it lasted

B4 WHO BEARS THE REFUND IS DECIDED BY A PERSON WITH A REASON (POST /admin/finance/adjustments/{id}/decide): a share above the refund is refused (422), a typed ledger account / status / balance is refused (422), and the decision posts ONE balanced transaction (Dr RESTAURANT_PAYABLE / Cr REFUND_CLEARING) and a NEW negative payable line — the earning line itself is what it was

C1 DRY RUN (POST /admin/finance/settlements/generate, dry_run): the calculation is answered — one settlement of 3 lines for the net of two earnings minus the refund the restaurant bears — and NOTHING is written (the lines of this run are dated one day back so that today's cutoff, 00:00 India time, lies after them)

C2 SETTLEMENT GENERATION UNDER A RACE: two requests at the same moment through two API processes make ONE settlement (CALCULATED) — every line was consumed exactly once, the second request found nothing left; generating sent no money and made no payout

C3 NO OPAQUE TOTAL (GET /admin/finance/settlements/{id}): the statement lists its lines — two ORDER_EARNING with gross / commission / net and one REFUND_ADJUSTMENT, each with its order number — and they add up to the net payable; it says it is a settlement statement and NOT a tax invoice; the queue shows it as calculated; live payouts are DISABLED

C4 APPROVAL: a typed status / paid_at / total is refused (422); "mark-paid", "paid", "pay", "status", "settle" are not routes (404); an administrator who only reads finance cannot approve (403); two approvals at the same moment are one approval (one audit event) — and approving sent no money

D1 PAYOUT DOUBLE-SUBMIT: two administrators' requests at the same moment through two API processes make ONE payout (the second is answered with the payout that exists); its amount is the settlement's (a typed amount or destination is refused, 422; an unconfirmed request is refused, 422); it was sent once with one idempotency key and is PROCESSING at the FAKE provider — the settlement is PAYMENT_PENDING and NOTHING is paid
D2 THERE IS NO "MARK AS PAID": the routes do not exist (404), a typed status is refused (422), and asking the provider again changes nothing while the provider itself says "processing"

D3 PAID ON TRUSTED EVIDENCE ONLY: the (fake) bank finishes the payout and the provider's signed webhook arrives TWICE — the payout is PAID once on the provider's own record, with ONE ledger posting (key payout:{id}:paid: Dr RESTAURANT_PAYABLE / Cr PAYOUT_CLEARING); the settlement is PAID for exactly its net; the restaurant is owed nothing

D4 PAYOUT → RESTAURANT DASHBOARD API: paid out = the settlement, available / in settlement / balance = 0; the statement reads PAID in the restaurant's own words with its payout; the payout list shows PAID with the destination as a MASK (the owner's to see) — no provider reference, no administrator, no token leaves the API to a restaurant

E1 POST-PAYOUT REFUND: the customer is refunded after the restaurant was paid and the decision is that the restaurant bears it — the historical payout, its settlement, its lines and its ledger posting are byte for byte what they were (HISTORICAL PAYOUT MUTATION = NO); what exists is a NEW negative payable line for a LATER settlement; the restaurant's balance is negative, shown as "finance review required" — no bank debit, no payout, no collection

E2 A NEGATIVE TOTAL IS NEVER A SETTLEMENT: generating now answers NEGATIVE_CARRIED_FORWARD — no settlement, no payout, nothing consumed; the line waits for the next earnings and the finance queue holds a NEGATIVE_RESTAURANT_BALANCE finding (FINANCE REVIEW REQUIRED)

F1 THE NEXT SETTLEMENT CARRIES THE ADJUSTMENT: a new earning covers the carried line — the settlement is the new earning minus the post-payout refund (2 lines), and the negative-balance finding closes by the rule that opened it (RESOLVED / AUTO_MATCHED)

F2 PAYOUT TIMEOUT: the provider makes the payout and its answer is lost — the payout is UNKNOWN (no provider reference, nothing paid); a second start is answered with the SAME payout; "send again" is refused (409 payout_not_retryable) — it was sent ONCE

F3 PAYOUT RECONCILIATION: asking the provider what it has for the payout's idempotency key FINDS the payout it made (PROCESSING, with the provider's reference); when the bank finishes it the payout is PAID — one payout, one posting, the settlement PAID, the restaurant owed nothing again

G1 MANUAL ADJUSTMENT: without a supporting reference it is refused (422); with a typed ledger account / debit / credit / balance it is refused (422); without the permission it is refused (403); with reason + reference it is ONE balanced posting (Dr PLATFORM_ADJUSTMENTS / Cr RESTAURANT_PAYABLE) and one payable line, and the same request again (same Idempotency-Key) is the same adjustment — no balance was edited

G2 FINANCIAL HOLD: a person holds a whole restaurant with a reason (audited) — settlement generation answers LOCATION_HELD and consumes nothing; after the release (with a reason, audited) the same line is settled

G3 A PAYOUT MADE OUTSIDE THE PLATFORM IS RECORDED WITH ITS EVIDENCE: another amount than the settlement's is refused (422 amount_mismatch), missing evidence is refused (422), bank details are refused (422), the permission is its own (403 for a reader); the record needs reference + day + amount + currency + reason + evidence and posts the SAME payout transaction a provider payout does — the settlement is PAID and cannot be paid again (409)

H1 PROVIDER SETTLEMENT IMPORT: the fake provider reports the day (4 payments with the fee and tax GIVEN to it — a test fixture, no fee formula exists — 3 refunds and one payment we never had); the import keeps every line as reported and matches each to our verified payment / completed refund by the provider's reference, amount and currency: 7 matched, 1 unmatched

H2 PROVIDER FEES ARE THE PROVIDER'S OWN FIGURES: for each matched payment the reported fee is posted net of its reported tax (Dr PROVIDER_FEE_EXPENSE + Dr PROVIDER_TAX_EXPENSE / Cr PROVIDER_CLEARING) — the platform bears them (policy PLATFORM_BORNE, pending approval); no restaurant payable moved

H3 WHAT DOES NOT AGREE STAYS VISIBLE: the payment the provider settled and we never had is an OPEN reconciliation difference (MISSING_INTERNAL_PAYMENT, HIGH) in the finance queue; the provider's settlement is kept as reported, marked DIFFERENCES and NOT posted as received; the source says FAKE_PROVIDER and that the Razorpay settlement API is PENDING PROVIDER VERIFICATION

H4 IMPORTED AGAIN — AND TWICE AT THE SAME MOMENT: the same provider records are ONE logical record each (8 lines, 1 settlement), nothing is posted again; a second import running at the same time is refused (409 import_running) or finds everything there

H5 DIFFERENCE RESOLUTION IS AUDITED: the numbers of a difference cannot be edited (422), a resolution needs a note (422), a reader of the queue cannot close (403); a finance administrator takes it up and resolves it with a resolution and a note — the audit log has who, from which state to which, and why

I1 LEDGER INTEGRITY (POST /admin/finance/checks LEDGER and php artisan finance:verify-ledger): every transaction balances, no currency mismatch, no duplicate or orphan posting, the restaurants' payable lines minus the paid payouts ARE the ledger's payable balances, no clearing account is on the wrong side — 0 problems

I2 INTERNAL RECONCILIATION (POST /admin/finance/checks INTERNAL): every paid order has its verified payment of the same amount and currency, no orphan payment, no refund above its payment, every paid payout is its settlement's amount, every financial event has its posting — 0 findings

I3 THE FINANCE OVERVIEW IS THE LEDGER (GET /admin/finance/overview): customer payments = the four payments, refunds = the three refunds, GROSS MARKETPLACE SALES = the three completed orders (labelled "not FoodOnTheGo revenue"), platform revenue = the commission only, restaurant payouts = the three paid payouts, provider fees = the imported figures ("never estimated"), restaurant payables 0 — and health says what is not real: payout provider FAKE_PROVIDER, live payouts DISABLED

J1 COMMISSION IS CONFIGURATION: a plan that would start in the past is refused (422 effective_from_in_the_past), a plan without a rate is refused (422 — there is no default rate); a future plan for one restaurant is created as SCHEDULED and labelled TEST; a rate cannot be edited (PATCH 405); orders already allocated keep their terms; an administrator without admin.finance.commission.view reads no plan and no rate (403); a plan that has not started can be withdrawn

J2 A RESTAURANT READS ITS OWN TERMS ONLY (GET /restaurant/finance/terms): Burger Hub sees the market's standard TEST plan (1000 bps, marked test_fixture — not a final commercial rate), with no reason, approver or reference; another organization asking for a Riverside location gets 404

K1 RESTAURANT ISOLATION: the owner of ANOTHER organization gets 404 for Riverside's settlement, its export, its summary, its earnings and its payouts, and its own summary names only its own location; ORDER_STAFF of Burger Hub has no finance permission (403); a MANAGER of two locations reads those two — and not where the payouts go (that is the owner's); a customer's token opens no finance API (401 / 404)

K2 ADMIN FINANCE RBAC: SUPPORT_ADMIN and RESTAURANT_ONBOARDING hold no finance permission (403 everywhere); OPERATIONS_ADMIN reads the overview, settlements, payouts and differences and can do NOTHING — generate, withdraw, pay, hold, import and the ledger are all 403; the ledger has no write route even for the finance administrator (405 / 404)

K3 EXPORTS: the settlement statement and the earnings of a period download as CSV (text/csv, attachment, the file name readable by the web application) with order numbers and amounts — no customer, no phone, no token; the statement says it is not a tax invoice; no cell starts as a spreadsheet formula; a period longer than 92 days is refused; each export is audited

U1 RESTAURANT DASHBOARD — EARNINGS (owner, all locations): the page is on the backend and shows the REAL figures of this run — paid out = the three confirmed payouts, balance 0, available 0 — per currency, with what each figure means, the note that the settlement schedule is not final and that live payouts are not enabled; nothing offers to mark anything as paid
